title: Russian Barley Pilaf
description: A hearty, comforting dish inspired by traditional Russian cuisine, made with barley, vegetables, and spices.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrot and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the mushroom and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the barley, thyme, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the barley is tender and the liquid has been absorbed, about 25-30 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
